ImageDescription.value: Taken in April 1999 when I made an extensive visit to the many lines of the FEVE system in northern Spain. This privately owned, narrow gauge system is a mixture of electrified and non-electrified lines stretching along the coast from Bilbao in the east to El Ferrol in the west. This view of EMU set 3518 is taken at Balmaseda. At the time this was a dead end terminus as far but has since been services have extended through from Bilbao all the way through to Leon.
